name: NOVAWING_PRE_PUBLIC_IP_GATE
revisionNote: Gate semantics correction: CLIENT_REQUIRED_SECRET_CONFLICT was moved out of blockingReasons (it blocks only on an explicit Owner KEEP_PRIVATE classification). publicRelease was not changed and the guard was not weakened.
patentDecisionRequired: candidate-1: authoritative task facts -> typed execution evidence -> independent deterministic verification -> evidence admission -> evidence-bound finalization
candidate-2: persisted verification plan -> scoped command/cwd admission -> source/script fingerprint revalidation -> independent verifier truth -> completion gate
candidate-3: bounded recovery -> authority-preserving diagnosis -> deterministic recovery admission -> re-verification -> fail-closed HUMAN_REQUIRED
clientRequiredSecretConflictRule: CLIENT_REQUIRED_SECRET_CONFLICT enters blockingReasons only for an item the Owner has explicitly classified KEEP_PRIVATE. No item shipped in v0.4.1 carries such a classification, so this conflict is recorded but is not a blocking reason. If the Owner later classifies any listed item as KEEP_PRIVATE, that item moves into blockingReasons.
blockingReasons: PATENT_DECISION_REQUIRED: three shipped mechanism combinations (candidate-1, candidate-2, candidate-3) are specific, are actually shipped in both packages, and have no confirmed prior public disclosure. The Owner must explicitly choose either to pursue/consult on a patent first, or to accept disclosure and forgo the pre-publication window. This gate makes no patentability judgement and does not decide for the Owner.

THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES FAIL: the macOS artifacts (NovaWing-0.4.1-arm64.dmg and NovaWing-0.4.1-arm64-mac.zip) ship no Electron/Chromium license text. LICENSE.electron.txt and LICENSES.chromium.html are present in the Windows installer payload but absent from the macOS app bundle, verified both by unpacking the ZIP and by read-only mounting the DMG.
nonBlockingObservations: CLIENT_REQUIRED_SECRET_CONFLICT (recorded, NOT blocking): recovery budgets, risk-scoring rules, the deterministic verifier allowlist, provider routing heuristics and the autonomous-diagnosis prompt ship inside client-executed code and cannot be removed without removing the feature. These are not classified KEEP_PRIVATE by the Owner, so they are retained as a recorded conflict and do not enter blockingReasons.
EULA_STATUS=NOT_DEFINED: root and shipped package.json are both UNLICENSED; no EULA or binary redistribution terms exist. Not a blocker unless the Owner has decided publishing requires one.
THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES is not defined in the repository; no notice document accompanies the release.
@posthog/core analytics telemetry is bundled in both packages, and @mastra/core ships its own upstream PostHog client key. Product/privacy decision, not an IP finding.

macOS notification-smoke reports report.result FAIL internally and is normalised to NEEDS_SIGNED_VALIDATION by the harness; packageSmokeResult=PASS is valid only together with the unsigned-bundle limitation.
No v0.4.1 real-host acceptance run exists; the recorded real-host evidence is v0.4.0 (Windows Phase 4, macOS Phase 5).

thirdPartyFindings.assessment: upstream Mastra package's own PostHog client-side ingestion key (phc_ prefix), published in the public npm package
truncated RSA key inside a documentation code fence

verifiedBy: find over unpacked ZIP app bundle

evidence.releaseNotesAudit: PASS - no checkpoint schema, evidence-admission algorithm, risk thresholds, recovery decision tree, verifier ranking, proprietary prompt text, or replicable state sequence

ownerDecisionsRequired: Patent: choose explicitly between (1) pursuing/consulting a patent before publication, or (2) accepting disclosure and forgoing the pre-publication window. This gate does not choose.
Third-party license text: decide whether to ship the Electron/Chromium license text in the macOS bundle (as Windows already does), or to record an accepted deviation.

Non-blocking classification check: confirm that none of the CLIENT_REQUIRED_SECRET_CONFLICT items is intended as KEEP_PRIVATE. If the Owner classifies any as KEEP_PRIVATE, that item becomes a blocking reason on the next run; this gate does not block on the conflict by itself.
